metadata.description: The Grok Build edition of LibreWhatsApp: the Grok-native libre-whatsapp-grok plugin plus the other LibreWhatsApp-Claude-Code plugins, pinned by commit. The pack's push plugin is held out: its --send flag skips the preview, and this edition's consent-gate refuses skip-gates.

plugins.name: libre-whatsapp-grok
plugins.description: Grok-native WhatsApp skills, draft-only: draft-reply writes the reply, template-scrub strips dark-pattern copy, and consent-gate holds every send until an explicit confirm phrase.

plugins.name: grab
plugins.description: Copy the latest shell command, URL, or code block someone sent in a WhatsApp chat straight to your clipboard.

plugins.name: pull
plugins.description: Read a WhatsApp chat (or a Discord channel or email thread) inside Claude Code: aliases from a local registry, only what is new since the last pull, verbatim quotes.

plugins.name: transcribe
plugins.description: Transcribe WhatsApp voice notes locally with whisper.cpp or OpenAI Whisper; the audio never leaves your machine.
